desc: Parse N and the N×N character matrix into adjacency lists per label.
Build BFS over states (u,v,p) with distance array; initialize all (i,i,0) with distance 0 and push to queue.
Implement transitions: (u,v,0) → (nu,nv,0) if label matches; (u,v,0) → (nu,v,1) for any outgoing edge from u; (u,v,0) → (u,nv,1) for any outgoing edge from v; (u,v,1) → (nu,nv,0) if labels match.
After BFS, for each (i,j) output distance[(j,j,0)] if finite else -1.
Format output as N rows of space-separated integers.
